## About
I'm a driven AI & Machine Learning engineer currently pursuing my B.Tech at Srinivas University. My passion lies at the intersection of data science and software engineering — building intelligent systems that turn raw data into actionable insights and real-world solutions.

From training deep learning models to deploying cloud-native applications, I thrive on tackling complex challenges. My toolkit spans Python, TensorFlow, AWS, Azure, and modern web technologies — and I'm always learning something new.

## Projects
### Gesture Flow
Control a presentation with your bare hands: the webcam tracks your gestures — open palm for the next slide, closed fist for the previous — so there is no clicker to lose.
Tags: Computer Vision, Gesture Control, Web App
Live: https://guestureflow.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/sudeenjain/guesture_flow

### FolioAI
Turns a GitHub ID, LinkedIn data and a resume (or a short bio) into a professional portfolio website in seconds — no coding required.
Tags: AI, Portfolio Generator, Web App
Live: https://portfolio-ai-eta-dusky.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/sudeenjain/folioAI

### CareerReady

Source: https://github.com/sudeenjain/CarrerReady

### Attendance Tracker
